description_en: Retrieves the details of a scene orchestration rule
description_zh: 获取场景联动规则详情
name: GetSceneRule

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scene orchestration rule. Invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169498.html operation to obtain the scene orchestration rule ID
parameters.help_zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169498.html接口获取场景联动规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时返回的数据

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the scene orchestration rule was created
GmtCreate.description_zh: 场景联动规则的创建时间

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the scene orchestration rule was last updated
GmtModified.description_zh: 场景联动规则最后一次更新的时间

RuleContent.description_en: The content of the scene orchestration rule

RuleDescription.description_en: The description of the scene orchestration rule

RuleName.description_en: The name of the scene orchestration rule

RuleStatus.description_en:
The status of the scene orchestration rule in the cloud.

0: stopped.

1: started
RuleStatus.description_zh:
场景联动规则在云端的状态。

0：表示停止。

1：表示启动

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates that the call was successful. A value of false indicates that the call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
